Topics · The holy books together

Why quote the Torah, Psalms and Gospel here?

The Quran names these books, honours them and sends its reader to their readers. Here is where it says so.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:46

Translation

The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient, in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

Original · Ancient Greek

δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον, ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,

2 Timothy · 2:24-25

World English Bible

A fair first suspicion: an app built on the Quran quotes other books only to score a point. Now look at what the Quran tells its own readers to say to the people of those books: we believe in what was sent to us and in what was sent to you, and our God and your God is one. That is why this app quotes them. Whoever takes that sentence seriously cannot treat those books as strangers. They stand inside the faith it describes.

A question for you

What did you expect when you saw other scriptures here?

If you sayAn attempt to bring them down.
ThenYou will not find that here. The app shows where those books and the Quran agree, and the rest of this Step says why.
If you sayA way of winning me over.
ThenA fair suspicion. The app does hope you will weigh the Quran. It says so openly and leaves the judging with you.
If you sayRespect for what I already hold.
ThenThat is what the verse asks for. The next part shows how far it goes.

Part 2 of 3

﴿إِنَّآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ كَمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَعِيسَىٰ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَـٰرُونَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants,[235] Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon; and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].

Translator's notes

[235] Al-Asbāṭ. See footnote to 2:136.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:163

Translation

I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

Original · Hebrew

וְדִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃

Hosea · 12:10

World English Bible

﴿وَقَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ فِيهِ هُدًى وَنُورٌ وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We sent, following in their footsteps,[267] Jesus, the son of Mary, confirming that which came before him in the Torah; and We gave him the Gospel, in which was guidance and light and confirming that which preceded it of the Torah as guidance and instruction for the righteous.

Translator's notes

[267] i.e., following the tradition of the prophets of the Children of Israel.

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:46

Translation

For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃

Proverbs · 6:23

World English Bible

﴿وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

Quran · Al-Ahqaf 46:12

The Quran does not pass these books by. It names them. David was given the Psalms. The Gospel given to Jesus held guidance and light, and it confirmed the Torah before it. The book of Moses was a guide and a mercy. Then the Quran says it stands next in that line, in Arabic. A book that places itself in a line gives its reader a reason to read what came before. So this app does.

A question for you

Which of these books do you know best?

If you sayThe Torah.
ThenThen you have a place to begin. Its passages appear after each Step, with their source and place.
If you sayThe Psalms.
ThenOne verse of the Quran says a promise was written in the Psalms. You will meet it further along this road.
If you sayThe Gospel.
ThenThen you will know much of what is shown after each Step, and you can check it for yourself.
If you sayNone of them yet.
ThenNothing here assumes that you do. You will see each text with its source.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَإِن كُنتَ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So if you are in doubt, [O Muḥammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters.

Quran · Yunus 10:94

﴿كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel [i.e., Jacob] had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muḥammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."

Quran · Aal Imran 3:93

Here is the boldest part. The Quran points to those books as witnesses. Speaking to Muhammad, it says: if you are in doubt about what was sent to you, ask those who read the Book before you. In another dispute it says: bring the Torah and read it. A book that dreaded the comparison would not open that door. So the app shows the matching passages with their sources and leaves the reading to you. It chooses what agrees, and it says so. You can open each book yourself.

A question for you

What would make you trust a comparison between two books?

If you saySeeing both texts with their sources.
ThenThat is what this app tries to give you, passage by passage.
If you sayReading each book whole, myself.
ThenThat is the best test of all. Each passage here is a place to begin, and nothing here replaces the book.
If you sayHearing from someone who holds that book.
ThenThe Quran itself names that route, and it has its own Step.
